newsitem.title: UK: Cordiant merges K Advertising into Saatchi/Saatchi.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant merges K Advertising into Saatchi/Saatchi.

text.p: Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising said on Wednesday it was merging a small London sister agency, K Advertising, into its global network. Both are owned by Cordiant Plc.
K Advertising has 34 employees and billings of 30 million stg. Its major clients include insurance company Commercial Union Plc and brewer Carlsberg A/S.
Saatchi & Saatchi joint chief executive, Adam Crozier, said in a statement that the merger would provide "unrivalled resources to clients and much broader career opportunities for staff."

Under the terms of the merger, K Advertising's chairman, Hamish Pringle, becomes vice chairman of Saatchi & Saatchi and will also take on the role of marketing director in a bid to build the Saatchi brand name.
"I fully support the merger and believe it is in the best interests of both our clients and our staff," said Pringle.

The merger means that Saatchi & Saatchi inherits instant client clashes between its own Norwich Union NRU.CN business and K's Commercial Union account and between Castlemaine XXXX and Carlsberg. Saatchi spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the conflicting accounts.
Six people have been made redundant as a result of the merger, which means the K Advertising brandname will cease to exist.
Industry sources told Reuters K Advertising's business had been going reasonably well, but it became dogged by market rumors that started a year ago about plans to be absorbed by Saatchi & Saatchi.
They said the rumors took on a life of their own, hampering K Advertising's business and making it difficult to recruit senior people.

"The market said the reality was K Advertising was going to merge with Saatchi & Saatchi. It become a self-fulfilling prophecy...It (the merger) ends the uncertainty within the company," said one source, who asked not to be identified.
